summary.text: Mark White is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 83 who has served since 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a small business owner and a former school principal.

paragraphs.text: Mark White graduated from the University of Memphis in 1974.
Ballotpedia says he previously worked as principal of Harding Academy in Memphis and is now a small business owner.
He assumed office in Tennessee House District 83 in 2010.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Education Administration Committee and a member of the Calendar and Rules and Education Instruction committees.
